crossRefs.note: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most…
“Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins…
You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifies the gold?
You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

translations.web: Seven days you shall make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and the altar shall be most holy. Whatever touches the altar shall be holy.
translations.bsb: For seven days you shall make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will become most holy; whatever touches the altar will be holy.
translations.kjv: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
translations.asv: Seven days thou shalt make atonement for the altar, and sanctify it: and the altar shall be most holy; whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy.
